name: Notifications & Parent–Teacher Communication

features.name: In-app notification centre: newest first, unread count, read/all read (confirmed), category/unread filters, pagination, safe navigation
Event model across categories reusing notifications/broadcastNotices/noticeReads (no duplicate system)
Idempotent generation (deterministic ids, same-commit, create-only), no drafts, no message text in notices
Notification preferences: own only, categories, critical not mutable, channel availability stated
Parent-teacher conversations: linked parent + child + slot teacher + opt-in; one child per conversation
Messaging safety: validation, length, attachments, no duplicates, no edit/delete, closed conversations, report/flag, admin access only after report
Conversation UI: list, new, thread, composer, attachments, unread, close/reopen/archive/report with confirmations, history; phone/tablet/desktop
Private attachments with participant-only Storage rules
